currentObservations.title: 模型路由能力出现多维优化信号
currentObservations.summary: 模型路由相关实践已出现多维优化信号：一类路由方法结合延迟、准确率和成本进行查询分配，实验结果显示相较标准负载均衡方式最高提升40%的accuracy-cost utility；另一类媒体模型路由能力已支持根据请求自动选择图像、视频或音频生成模型。以上为跨来源并行信号，不代表长期趋势判断。
currentObservations.strategic_implication: 同对象相关指标与跨来源并行信号显示，模型路由理解已从简单请求分发扩展到延迟、准确率、成本联合优化及自动选择模型的应用形态。

facts.subject: prior_router_limitation
facts.statement: Existing query routers are largely latency-agnostic and do not consider the generation latency experienced by queries at model instances.

facts.subject: latency_influencing_factors
facts.statement: Query latency depends on prompt length, current prefill and decode workload at the model instance, and the serving framework's scheduling and batching policy.

evidence_cards.source_quote: Incorporating query latency into routing is challenging as it depends not only on the query's prompt length, but also on the current prefill and decode workload at the model instance and the scheduling and batching policy of the serving framework
